Subject: MedCura security intake: SOC 2, network isolation & next steps

Hi Elena / MedCura security team,

Great speaking with you this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Ask summary from the call
- Primary concern: confirm Redwood's controls for PHI/PII in a private deployment and options for network isolation (VPC peering, dedicated VPC with strict egress rules, or an air-gapped on-prem install).
- Evidence requests: latest SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 letter of attestation), encryption-at-rest documentation, KMS/HSM options, and a vendor security questionnaire filled out.

2) Deliverables we agreed to share
- MedCura: send over your vendor security questionnaire and any initial network sketch showing where Redwood would sit in your topology (we discussed public cloud VPC vs. air-gap).
- Redwood: provide a brief deployment checklist, a sample network diagram for our private VPC option, and a checklist of evidence we can produce for a SOC 2 / HIPAA review.

3) Timeline
- Goal: surface initial answers and a proposed deployment sketch within 2 business days, then iterate toward evidence delivery within 10 business days depending on what MedCura needs from legal/compliance.

I've attached our Redwood Private deployment checklist to give your team a sense of the artifacts we typically produce. Please reply with the questionnaire when you have it and any timings for your internal compliance review.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Rafael—thanks for the recap and for the checklist. Attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire and a very rough network sketch we pulled together this morning (see attached). A few clarifying items from our side:  

- SOC 2: We need to see either a SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months or a SOC 2 + bridge letter confirming controls are in place. 
- Data residency: our production data for EU patients must remain in an EU region; please confirm whether Redwood supports deployment in eu-west-1 (or similar) for private deployments.
- KMS/HSM: we use Azure Key Vault and can require HSM-backed keys for encryption at rest — does Redwood integrate with customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key)?
- Air-gapped option: if an air-gapped on-prem install is required, we need an outline of the installation footprint (compute, storage, networking) and an estimate of effort.

We're attaching: MedCura_Security_Questionnaire.pdf and medcura_network_sketch_v1.png. Please confirm receipt and next steps for evidence. 

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Engineering, MedCura Health
elena.rossi@medcura.com
Attachment: MedCura_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 680KB)
Attachment: medcura_network_sketch_v1.png (png, 120KB)
